restaurantName: Le Bistrot du Château de Berne
address: Château de Berne, chemin des Imberts, Flayosc, 83780, France
bio: The simple, sun-drenched menu is packed with ingredients that call to mind the surrounding landscape. Crunchy local asparagus; rack of Duroc de Bataillé pork with an Asian twist; apple pastry, almond cream and caramel. These fresh, unfussy dishes are accompanied by wines from the estate. The prices are reasonable, and efficient service is provided by a team who are able to converse with the substantial English-speaking clientele....
pageTitle: Le Bistrot du Château de Berne
